stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Ukraine wirft Russland Angriffe auf Energieanlagen vor

en.title: War against Ukraine: Ukraine accuses Russia of attacks on energy facilities
en.summary: Despite Trump's announcement of an energy weapons ceasefire in the Ukraine conflict over the weekend, Russia continues to attack Ukrainian energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Podcast »House of Block«: DIE ZEIT verurteilt angedrohte Durchsuchung der Redaktion

en.title: Podcast "House of Block": DIE ZEIT condemns threatened search of editorial offices
en.summary: Hamburg prosecutors and state police visited Die Zeit's offices regarding investigations into the Block case. The newspaper plans legal action against the threatened search.

stories.title: Ilhan Omar: US-Ermittler durchsuchen Haus von Donald-Trump-Kritikerin

en.title: Ilhan Omar: US investigators search home of Donald Trump critic
en.summary: An ICE division is investigating Democratic congresswoman Ilhan Omar over alleged irregularities in her naturalization process. Trump previously made derogatory statements about her.

stories.title: CDU in der Krise: Was der Rückzug von Bärbel Bas für Friedrich Merz bedeutet

en.title: CDU in crisis: What Bärbel Bas's withdrawal means for Friedrich Merz
en.summary: As Friedrich Merz seeks to prevent the CDU's decline and the party holds strategy meetings, SPD leader Bärbel Bas's sudden withdrawal occurs.

stories.title: Landtag Sachsen-Anhalt: Verlässt die CDU bei der Ministerpräsidentenwahl den Saal?

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt state parliament: Will the CDU leave the chamber during the minister-president election?
en.summary: The headline raises the question of whether CDU members might leave the chamber during Saxony-Anhalt's minister-president election.

stories.title: Fall Block: Ermittler beschlagnahmen Podcast-Aufnahmen bei »Zeit«-Autorin

en.title: Block case: Investigators seize podcast recordings at Die Zeit author
en.summary: Hamburg authorities secured audio recordings from a Die Zeit podcast, with the publication's editorial leadership characterizing the action as an attack on press freedom.

stories.title: Bärbel Bas’ Rücktritt: Friedrich Merz weist Kritik am Umgang mit Bärbel Bas zurück

en.title: Bärbel Bas's resignation: Friedrich Merz rejects criticism of handling of Bärbel Bas
en.summary: Chancellor Merz disputes criticism from Bärbel Bas and the SPD regarding his conduct, stating he requested Christian consideration toward Bas from his party.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: CDU-Politiker empfehlen Fraktion, bei Ministerpräsidentenwahl geschlossen den Saal zu verlassen

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: CDU politicians recommend faction walk out during minister-president election
en.summary: CDU officials are considering whether to have their parliamentary members leave the chamber during the minister-president vote as a precautionary measure against potential hidden support for an AfD candidate.

stories.title: Serena Bilanceri: Israel verweigert Arbeitserlaubnis für »taz«-Korrespondentin

en.title: Serena Bilanceri: Israel refuses work permit for taz correspondent
en.summary: Israel's government has denied entry to a taz newspaper correspondent, accusing her of calling for boycotts. The newspaper called the decision unacceptable.

stories.title: News des Tages: Bärbel Bas tritt zurück, EU-Sanktionen gegen Russland, Alexander Zverev führt bald Weltrangliste an

en.title: News of the day: Bärbel Bas resigns, EU sanctions against Russia, Alexander Zverev to lead world rankings soon
en.summary: German Labour Minister and SPD co-chair Bärbel Bas resigned. The EU approved new sanctions against Russia while the US continues business dealings with Putin. Tennis player Alexander Zverev will become world number one.

stories.title: Tödlicher Bungee-Unfall: Beim ersten Sprung hielt die selbst gebaute Vorrichtung noch

en.title: Fatal bungee accident: The homemade device held during the first jump
en.summary: Details emerged following a fatal bungee jump by a 21-year-old woman. An expert expressed surprise at the homemade equipment used.

stories.title: Warstein: 21-Jährige stirbt beim Bungee-Jumping – Polizei spricht von »tragischem Unfall«

en.title: Warstein: 21-year-old dies while bungee jumping – police call it "tragic accident"
en.summary: A group built their own bungee-jumping equipment at a former quarry in Warstein. A 21-year-old died during her jump, and police have released new findings about the death.

stories.title: Dax aktuell: Dax notiert im Plus – VW-Aktie legt zu

en.title: Dax currently: Dax trades in positive territory – VW share gains
en.summary: Germany's main stock index continued its recent upward trend in quiet trading on Monday, with oil price movements having little impact on the overall performance.

stories.title: Gastkommentar: Wir müssen die deutsche Wissenschaft besser schützen

en.title: Guest commentary: We must better protect German science
en.summary: A federal lawmaker argues that Germany's federal and state governments should establish binding rules for scientific cooperations with countries like China, citing vulnerabilities revealed by a recent case.

stories.title: Automesse: Neue Modelle, neue Anbieter: Chinas Autobauer drängen immer stärker auf den europäischen Markt

en.title: Auto show: New models, new providers: Chinese automakers increasingly push into the European market
en.summary: Record numbers of Chinese car brands are exhibiting at the Paris Auto Show as their EU market share grows rapidly, though the impact of European hybrid compromises remains uncertain.

stories.title: Kommentar: Diese Innovation bei BMW sollte sich die deutsche Wirtschaft abschauen

en.title: Commentary: This innovation at BMW should be adopted by German industry
en.summary: BMW plans to deploy an AI agent next year to reduce costs by hundreds of millions, with potential applications across the broader industrial sector.

stories.title: Bundesregierung: Drei Reformen, null Schonfrist: Schweitzer übernimmt das vielleicht härteste Ministerium der Koalition

en.title: Federal government: Three reforms, zero grace period: Schweitzer takes over what may be the toughest ministry in the coalition
en.summary: Schweitzer succeeds Bärbel Bas in a ministerial role dealing with initiatives that could determine the government's survival. He brings relevant experience but previously opposed one of the major reforms now under his purview.
